description: ZECPATH AI Day 45 HR Interview demonstration dataset.

interview.question: Tell me about yourself.
interview.response: I recently completed my B.Tech in Information Technology. I have worked on software projects involving Python, web development and AI-related applications. I enjoy solving practical problems and learning new technologies.

interview.question: What are your strengths?
interview.response: My main strengths are problem solving, willingness to learn and consistency. In projects, I try to understand the requirement first and then break the problem into smaller tasks.

interview.question: Tell me about a time you worked as part of a team.
interview.response: During a project, I worked with other members on different modules. I was responsible for my assigned development work and coordinated with the team when integrating the modules. We discussed issues and tested the combined functionality before completion.

interview.question: Where do you see yourself in the next few years?
interview.response: I want to become a strong software engineer with practical experience in backend systems, AI-enabled applications and production software development. I also want to take more responsibility as my technical and communication skills improve.

interview.question: Why are you interested in this software engineering role?
interview.response: The role matches my interest in software development and problem solving. I want to work on real systems, learn from experienced developers and contribute to production features while improving my engineering practices.

interview.question: Are you available to commit to the role and its working requirements?
interview.response: Yes. I am prepared to commit to the role and follow the team's working requirements. I am also comfortable learning the tools and processes used by the organization.

interview.question: Do you have anything else you would like to add?
interview.response: I am interested in the opportunity and would be happy to contribute while continuing to learn and develop as an engineer.
